novelty_search.nearest_results: Fresh has/had constructions were already tested, including one valid v7 screen and later capability-invalid OOD panels. Narrative tense uses L11H3 and its fresh value test was capability-invalid. The new will/had authority is fully capable and selective at resid:18, but no attention module passed its generic screen and no L9H1/H4 local-value reuse test exists.
novelty_search.new_question: Without fitting or choosing a new head, does the exact MLP4-to-L9H1/H4 routing/local-value computation identified in has/had and is/was predict a new future-versus-anterior auxiliary construction?

population: All 64 A1/A2 rows from the sealed will/had authority, in two fixed 32-row construction batches. The temporal cue is the sole aligned token change and the contextual bank is the following two tokens.

factorization.fixed_writer: The already defined exact MLP4 left_change+right_change response is installed at the two contextual-bank tokens; no coefficient is fitted.
factorization.arms: All eight factor subsets enter otherwise native base L9H1/H4 immediately before c_proj.
factorization.structural_control: MLP4 occurs after layer 0, so V1 must remain invariant; the three factors must close to the exact hybrid-minus-base contextual-bank head term.
factorization.no_rescue: No prompt, row, source bank, head, factor, sign, threshold, or aggregation may change after execution.

opposing_predictions.shared_edge: The two-term MLP4 writer and complete H1/H4 bank route are positive with direction fraction at least 0.75 in both constructions; the local V9 factor is the largest Shapley term and alone retains at least 0.60 of the full factor effect.
opposing_predictions.late_or_different_route: The writer or H1/H4 bank route is below the registered recurrence bars, or routing/interaction rather than local V9 dominates. This bounds the typed shared edge to the previously tested aspectual/copular constructions.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_factor: The sealed authority hashes hold; every A1/A2 direction/side has native accuracy at least 0.85; V1, effective-value, source, empty-hook, and factor closure errors are at most 1e-4 except the inherited MLP4 tensor tolerance at most 2e-3; all records are present.
predictions.pred_b_prospective_writer_and_bank_recur: The two-term MLP4 writer has mean recovery at least 0.10 and the full L9H1/H4 bank factors have mean recovery at least 0.05, with positive family means and direction fraction at least 0.75 for A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_c_local_value_edge_reuses: Local V9 content has positive Shapley recovery, exceeds routing and interaction in A1/A2, and its single arm retains at least 0.60 of the full effect with direction fraction at least 0.75.
predictions.pred_d_interaction_is_secondary: Routing plus local value without their interaction retains at least 0.80 of the full effect with direction fraction at least 0.75 in A1/A2.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: Exactly 24 model forwards, 768 example evaluations, 512 intervention records, eight arms across two batches, and zero fits/searches/backwards/updates.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: the exact local-L9-value edge predicts the new temporal-auxiliary construction without refitting.
terminal.null: The instrument and price pass, but prospective writer/bank recurrence, local-value dominance, or secondary-interaction prediction fails.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, exactness, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.

scope: A screen would extend one internal edge computation, not identify the full will/had circuit. A null would not retract the established has/had and is/was edge; it would bound its reuse class.
